title: A protocol-12 mainnet ledger: LedgerCloseMeta v0 and only V0 envelopes
pattern: Before protocol 13 every envelope is ENVELOPE_TYPE_TX_V0 (raw ed25519 source, no MuxedAccount) in a classic TransactionSet, and LedgerCloseMeta is v0. In SDF's lake the TransactionMeta is v4 (Galexie's BACKFILL_STELLAR_ASSET_EVENTS).

hazards.placement: TransactionMeta v4 at protocol 12 because of a node flag

facts.says: The transaction set is classic, with 532 envelopes.
The first envelope is tx_v0: its source is a raw ed25519 key (source_account_ed25519), not a MuxedAccount.
